question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a silver ball, Bob has a pink ball, Claire has a teal ball, Dave has a white ball, Eve has a gold ball, Fred has a orange ball, and Gertrude has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Eve and Dave swap balls. Then, Bob and Fred swap balls. Then, Eve and Dave swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Then, Alice and Eve swap balls. Finally, Claire and Eve swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) silver ball
(B) pink ball
(C) teal ball
(D) white ball
(E) gold ball
(F) orange ball
(G) brown ball
solution:
Ball colors in holder order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: silver, pink, teal, white, gold, orange, brown.
1. Eve ↔ Dave: silver, pink, teal, gold, white, orange, brown.
2. Bob ↔ Fred: silver, orange, teal, gold, white, pink, brown.
3. Eve ↔ Dave: silver, orange, teal, white, gold, pink, brown.
4. Gertrude ↔ Fred: silver, orange, teal, white, gold, brown, pink.
5. Bob ↔ Claire: silver, teal, orange, white, gold, brown, pink.
6. Alice ↔ Eve: gold, teal, orange, white, silver, brown, pink.
7. Claire ↔ Eve: gold, teal, silver, white, orange, brown, pink.
Alice holds the gold ball, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
